Initial release of DeFi Yield Optimizer skill.

- Provides discovery, tracking, and optimization of DeFi yields across Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche, and more.
- Supports real-time APY/APR tracking, ROI calculation, impermanent loss analysis, and gas optimization.
- Includes risk assessment, protocol audit tracking, and yield alerts.
- Portfolio analytics with performance, diversification, and historical reporting features.
- Integrates with over 100 protocols and multiple EVM chains.
- Offers customizable risk/return filters, daily reports, and export capabilities.
